description: This file defines a hierarchy of exception classes used in the PyTorch Inductor runtime caching system, including custom errors for cache operations, lock timeouts, and encoding/decoding issues.

classes.name: CacheError
classes.description: Base class for all caching-related errors.

classes.name: SystemError
classes.description: Base class for system-level caching errors, inherits from CacheError and RuntimeError.

classes.name: LockTimeoutError
classes.description: Error raised when a lock operation times out, inherits from SystemError.

classes.name: FileLockTimeoutError
classes.description: Error raised when a file lock operation times out, inherits from SystemError.

classes.name: UserError
classes.description: Base class for user-facing cache errors, inherits from CacheError and TypeError.

classes.name: KeyEncodingError
classes.description: Error during cache key encoding operations, inherits from UserError.

classes.name: ValueEncodingError
classes.description: Error during cache value encoding operations, inherits from UserError.

classes.name: ValueDecodingError
classes.description: Error during cache value decoding operations, inherits from UserError.

methods.name: LockTimeoutError.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the error with lock object and timeout details.

methods.name: FileLockTimeoutError.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the error with file lock object and timeout details.

calls: f"Failed to acquire lock {lock} within {timeout} seconds."
f"Failed to acquire file lock {flock} within {timeout} seconds."
